title: Fetchlinks collection catalog (contract v1)
description: What the collector should collect: feed and subreddit identity only. Exported from the destination by a publisher, then read by the collector, which is how the collector learns about admin changes without holding database credentials. Carries no health, no cursors, and no counters -- only the subscription list.

revision.description: Digest of the entries alone. Stable while the subscription list is unchanged, so a batch's catalog_revision says which list produced it.

source.description: Where this snapshot came from, for diagnosis only.

normalized_url.description: Natural key tying observations back to this feed.

name.description: Display form, preserving the case a human typed.

normalized_name.description: Lowercase natural key, also the path segment requested.
